title: Harness failures leave sockets and background work running
test: tests/benchmarkRuntime.test.js: 'benchmark closes its sockets and exits 1 when the warm-up metrics request fails', 'benchmark stops its acknowledgement loops, closes its sockets and exits 1 when sampling fails mid-run', 'benchmark closes the sockets that did connect and exits 1 when one connection is refused'; tests/churnRuntime.test.js: 'churn harness closes its whole pool and exits 1 when the baseline metrics request fails', 'churn harness closes the host that connected before a refused viewer and exits 1' (plus 'churn harness still closes its pool and exits 1 when only the settled metrics request fails', a guard for the one path that already closed its pool); unit tests in tests/runtimeHarnessCleanup.test.js for the new helpers
proof: Each test runs the script as a child process against a local http + socket.io fixture that can fail a metrics request with HTTP 500 or refuse the Nth handshake (like the connection limiter), then asserts: the process exited by itself within 10 s (not killed), exit code 1, the failure message on stderr, zero sockets still connected on the fixture, and that every socket that had connected ended with the server-side reason 'client namespace disconnect' (the script closed it; it was not dropped with the process). On the unchanged code the five new failure-path tests failed with AssertionError 'the harness should exit by itself: true !== false': the open sockets kept the event loop alive, the process never exited and the test harness had to kill it after 10 s (warm-up failure, mid-run sampling failure, one refused connect among three clients in the benchmark; failed baseline fetch with 4 pool sockets open, and a refused viewer that left its already-connected host open, in churn). The sixth, settled-metrics failure in churn, passed before and after (that path already closed the pool). After the fix all of them pass: the benchmark connects with Promise.allSettled, registers each socket as soon as it is created, and wraps the connect/warm-up/sampling phase in try/finally that sets running=false, waits for the ack loops (bounded), then closes every socket; the churn harness registers every socket in allSockets as soon as it is created, wraps pool setup, baseline, the loops and the settled sample in try/finally that stops the loops and closes allSockets (including a host whose viewer never connected). Runs with complete metrics still pass with the same summaries and exit code 0.
